reference_sql:
SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN competitor_prices cp ON cp.product_id = p.product_id AND cp.competitor = 'Stroomhuis'
WHERE cp.product_id IS NULL
alternatives: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name FROM competitor_prices cp RIGHT JOIN products p ON p.product_id = cp.product_id AND cp.competitor = 'Stroomhuis' WHERE cp.product_id IS NULL

SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name FROM products p LEFT JOIN competitor_prices cp ON cp.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cp.competitor = 'Stroomhuis') = 0

other_way.sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name FROM products p LEFT JOIN competitor_prices cp ON cp.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cp.competitor = 'Stroomhuis') = 0
other_way.tradeoff: Counting Stroomhuis checks per product with FILTER and keeping 0 works, but it joins every check before discarding them.
